source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Divine Strength
ranks: Increases your Strength by 2%.

talents.name: Divine Intellect
ranks: Increases your total Intellect by 2%.

talents.name: Spiritual Focus
ranks: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Seals
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 0%.

talents.name: Healing Light
ranks: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 4%.

talents.name: Consecration
ranks: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec.

talents.name: Unyielding Faith
ranks: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

talents.name: Illumination
ranks: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 0% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

talents.name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
ranks: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 10%.
Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 20%.

talents.name: Divine Favor
ranks: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

talents.name: Lasting Judgement
ranks: Increases the duration of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom by 10 sec.
Increases the duration of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom by 20 sec.
Increases the duration of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom by 30 sec.

talents.name: Holy Power
ranks: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by 0%.

talents.name: Holy Shock
ranks: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 175 to 189 Holy damage to an enemy, or 150 to 162 healing to an ally.

talents.name: Improved Devotion Aura
ranks: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 5%, and increases all healing received by party members affected by your Auras by 2%.

talents.name: Redoubt
ranks: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 0%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

talents.name: Precision
ranks: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Guardian's Favor
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 1 min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 3 sec.

talents.name: Toughness
ranks: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

talents.name: Blessing of Kings
ranks: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hr. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
ranks: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 6%.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
ranks: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 10%.
Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 20%.
Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana.

talents.name: Anticipation
ranks: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
ranks: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Concentration Aura
ranks: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 15%, and your Concentration Aura also reduces the duration of Silence and Interrupt effects on your party members by 30%.

talents.name: Reckoning
ranks: Gives you a 0% chance after Blocking and a 0% chance after receiving a non-periodic critical strike to gain an extra attack. Stores up to 4 extra attacks.

talents.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
ranks: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

talents.name: Holy Shield
ranks: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

talents.name: Improved Blessing of Might
ranks: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 4%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 8%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 12%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 16%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 20%.

talents.name: Benediction
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Judgement
ranks: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by 1 sec.

talents.name: Improved Seal of the Crusader
ranks: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 5%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 10%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 15%.

talents.name: Deflection
ranks: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Vindication
ranks: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 0 for 30 sec.

talents.name: Conviction
ranks: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Seal of Command
ranks: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 48.5 Holy damage, 93 to 101 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

talents.name: Pursuit of Justice
ranks: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by 15%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

talents.name: Eye for an Eye
ranks: All critical strikes against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

talents.name: Improved Retribution Aura
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by 25%.
Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by 50%.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
ranks: Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by 2%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

talents.name: Sanctity Aura
ranks: Increases Holy damage done by party members within 30 yards by 10%. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

talents.name: Vengeance
ranks: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 5% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Repentance
ranks: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.
